notes: Implement a real bounded random-walk Metropolis sampler for a truncated normal and generalize to fresh configs (different support/center/scale/n/seed). Difficulty comes from the statistical-correctness requirements: hidden cases probe support enforcement, heavy truncation (moments far off center/scale require truncated-normal math, not naive untruncated samples), exact retained count after burn-in, and fixed-seed reproducibility. A plausible-looking but wrong sampler (uniform draws, ignoring truncation, or leaking burn-in) fails the moment/count checks, so quantitative_correctness, hidden_case_generalization and adversarial_inputs carry the score. Single self-contained stdlib file; no external deps.
